type T = `${{x:1}}`;
type Prefix<U> = `a${U}`;
type P2<U extends string> = `a${U}`;
type P3<U extends object> = `a${U}`;
type P4 = `a${symbol}`;
type P5 = `a${unknown}`;
type P6 = `a${any}`;
type P7 = `a${never}`;
type P8 = `a${string | {}}`;
type P9 = `a${boolean | null | undefined | bigint | number}`;
type P10<U extends string | number> = `a${U}`;
type P11 = `a${void}`;
type P12 = `a${string[]}`;
type P13<U extends string> = `a${Uppercase<U>}`;
type P14<O> = `a${keyof O}`;
type P15<O> = `a${keyof O & string}`;

type Bad<T> = { [K in keyof T as `get${K}`]: () => T[K] };
